title: Isolated Singularities of k-Hessian Equations
summary: We classify isolated singularities of nonpositive, $k$-admissible classical solutions to $k$-Hessian equations without radial symmetry assumptions. For $1\le k 0$ and $0\le\ell<n$. The proofs combine Hessian-measure compactness, Wolff-potential estimates, a global Bôcher theorem, and a bounded-variation analysis of spherical extrema.
